high-altitude courier, 1920s, rendered as photoreal render concept art moodboard, a neutral commercial grade, washed linen

Never copy a specific person or a copyrighted character from the moodboard — take palette, mood and material language only.

Grade target: a sun-bleached grade with faded blacks and a green-yellow bias. Lighting reference: a hair light and background separation light with the key pulled two stops down.

Return the design lock as one dense paragraph, no headings, no commentary.
